topic.title: Alpine Ski House to open 14 new resorts by 2029
topic.angle: Capacity expansion in leisure: demand signal or overbuild?

sources.title: Alpine Ski House plans 14 new resorts by 2029
sources.text: Alpine Ski House plans to open 14 new resorts in Europe by 2029, the company said on Friday, as it bets on continued demand for mountain holidays. The expansion will cost about EUR 900m and add roughly 5,000 rooms, the company said in a statement. Chief executive Ingrid Solberg said bookings for the coming winter season were 9% higher than a year earlier. The company did not say how the expansion would be financed.
